Another tower built beside the old one to carry the county's transmitters, as stated by the emergency director (May 2022)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The May 2022 article's photo caption says the board voted to accept a bid, but its body text says the board rejected the bid and re-advertised. The August 2022 article records the bid accepted, so the story uses the body text for May and the August article for the acceptance.

notes_for_editor: The OpenStreetMap record is named Lafayette Lookout Tower (node 357997316, 182 m). Linking it to the Thacker Mountain fire tower rests on the county match and the Oxford Eagle coverage; the coordinates were not checked against a Thacker Mountain location. No source gives a build date, height or design. The 2023 column (published 2 August 2023) gives no dates for the watch. Two web searches found only these newspaper items; no county, Mississippi Forestry Commission or photo record was reached. The record name could take the local name as an alias. Demolition is not confirmed; the column's past-tense wording suggests the tower was taken down, but no source dates it.
